subject: Providing model averaged detection estimates for occupancy model

messages.author: 1cad400e913f30eb
messages.subject: Providing model averaged detection estimates for occupancy model
parts:
I am using a two-stepped approach for modeling occupancy.  First, I determine the "best" detection model while keeping the occupancy side of the model as the null model (i.e. ~ air + water + time ~ 1).  In the second step, I am holding the detection side of the model constant as the top model from the first step.  This is followed by model averaging over the 95% confidence set.  My question is this: is there a way to supply model averaged detection parameter estimates to the second step rather than simply using the top detection model?  Can i do this with the "starts" argument?  If so, how do I incorporate the variability of the estimates?

Thanks,
Nick Smeenk

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: RE: [unmarked] Providing model averaged detection estimates for occupancy model
parts:
Hi Nick,

I believe you can't do that. Reason is that you need an explicit parametric model, and a model-averaged model (in the sense of how MA is done with maximum likelihood in unmarked) is not that. Perhaps if one could fix parameters in unmarked, then you could concoct some ad-hoc solution by some form of parametric boostrapping for the detection part of the model, but, alas, one can not.

Sorry that's not very helpful, perhaps somebody else has better ideas.

Marc
